0022600148.text: The Charlotte Hornets (3-3, on a two-game losing streak and 8th in the East) host the Philadelphia 76ers (5-1, on a two-game winning streak and 2nd in the East, first in the Atlantic). The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, and the Hornets lost the 2025-26 series 1-2, including a 118-114 loss in Charlotte on March 28, 2026. Charlotte is missing Coby White, Grant Williams, Kon Knueppel and Kylan Boswell, while Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti, Dominick Barlow, Jabari Walker, Jaylen Brown and Tacko Fall.
